alpha: PNG straight (unassociated); browser source-over; do not premultiply again
render_device: OPTIX: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (Brief 57 cloud production; Brief 58 home QA)
depth_slices_note: Disjoint Cycles world-position AOV masks; render_layers reconstruct each parent exactly. 1x derives from linear 2x pixels with coverage-weighted positions. Wet highlights share the same ownership and depth.
full_composition: Native background phase 0, depth-sorted foreground and wet highlights, vacant WC, then 1080p rain_fg. No static glow overlay.
loop_note: Native nonnegative light/reflection/rain difference above its matching temporal-minimum base and below actors/occluders. Indoor and shelter rain protection remains; the old billboard/marquee protection masks are removed. Foreground rain is a separate additive stream. Use full.png as the flattened still fallback. DINK DONK bell holds A12/B12 (0.50 seconds/state); CINEMAS and shielded central flood are baked into this pack. Brief 95: same loop contract; base and loop were rendered together from the draft 32 scene.

vehicle_sprite_contract.anchor: Ground point at middle of vehicle / lane centre, in logical 1x pixels. Position top-left at P(u,v)-anchor.
vehicle_sprite_contract.resolution: @2x images have exactly twice the pixels. Use the 1x CSS w/h and anchor, or multiply all coordinates by two on a 2x canvas.
vehicle_sprite_contract.alpha: Body: straight RGBA with soft contact shadow. Light: RGB on black, plus-lighter under all vehicles and walkers.
vehicle_sprite_contract.crop: Closed body, open body and their light images share w/h and anchor within each direction. The common tight crop includes the light reach.
vehicle_sprite_contract.depth: Place body with z_index = 1000 + round((u+v)*100); road-light layers go below all bodies and static occluders.
vehicle_sprite_contract.direction: True 180-degree 3D rotation, not mirrored images; destination and TAXI text remain legible.
vehicle_sprite_contract.door: Optional door_open files replace the closed pair at the identical anchor. The entry is on local -v (curb side for +u).

lit_bg_composition: Fully lit phase-0 background; draw render_layers and other foreground assets above it.

prop_loop_contract.format: Use each entry blend and alpha: RGB on black for plus-lighter, straight RGBA for source-over.
prop_loop_contract.playback: frame = floor(elapsedSeconds * fps) % frames; source cell (frame % columns, floor(frame / columns)).
prop_loop_contract.resolution: All rects, frame_width/frame_height and z_index use the 1920x1080 coordinate system. @2x doubles each cell and the sheet, not CSS placement.
prop_loop_contract.sorting: Insert each crop at its z_index in the same walker/prop stack, immediately above its listed parent_slices. Do not place below occluder sprites.
prop_loop_contract.phase: Use per-entry fps/frames, including one-cell steady entries and six-second 12fps water/bulbs; do not assume a common sheet length.
prop_loop_contract.fallback: Pause at any cell for reduced motion. Omit sheets if unsupported; the static props remain complete.
prop_loop_contract.popcorn: Native 2x Cycles geometry, rotating lobed kernels on periodic arcs, attenuated through the existing glass and occluded by kettle/cabinet geometry.
prop_loop_contract.signs: Three menu backlights, soda logo and selections, a single E in TICKETS, and original INSERT COIN arcade pixel art.

vehicle_slice_contract.placement: Whole top-left = P(u,v)-direction.anchor. Slice top-left = whole top-left + [slice.x,slice.y].
vehicle_slice_contract.depth: For each slice use 1000 + round((u + slice.du + v) * 100). du is signed world-u offset, including -u vehicles.
vehicle_slice_contract.resolution: x/y/w/h remain logical 1x pixels. file_2x has exactly double the dimensions. Slices replace the whole body, not its lights.
vehicle_slice_contract.reconstruction: Disjoint surface-owned pixels reconstruct the inherited straight RGBA body exactly, including its contact shadow.
vehicle_slice_contract.sections: World-space longitudinal bins no longer than one tile, from actual geometry bounds; shadow-only pixels use their floor position.
vehicle_slice_contract.door_open: Use door_open.slices with the same parent anchor and dimensions when the door is open.
vehicle_slice_contract.fallback: The inherited whole-body sprite and centre-depth contract remain available for consumers without slice support.

vehicle_lamp_variant_contract.composition: Each new light is a complete replacement for light, on black for plus-lighter below all bodies. Do not add normal and variant together.
vehicle_lamp_variant_contract.brake: Brighter red tail halo and ray-traced wet-road reflection; available for every direction and closed/open body.
vehicle_lamp_variant_contract.indicator: Bus/taxi curb-side amber signal ON, including road reflections. Blink by alternating this complete light with normal.
vehicle_lamp_variant_contract.combined: For simultaneous braking and indicator, add max(indicator-normal,0) to brake, clamped to 255; do not double headlights.
vehicle_lamp_variant_contract.anchor: All variants preserve the published light dimensions and the direction anchor.

cat_contract.character: Original small ginger tabby with cream paws and chest, about 0.45 tiles long including tail; stylized to read beside 50px emotes.
cat_contract.placement: Frame top-left = P(u,v) - anchor; anchor is ground under body centre. Sort the cat at 1000 + round((u+v)*100).
cat_contract.frames: RGBA, straight alpha, row-major. frame=floor(timeSeconds*fps)%frames for loops. Clamp at frames-1 for stretch.
cat_contract.resolution: Coordinates and 64x64 frame size are 1x; @2x doubles every cell and sheet. Keep 1x CSS placement.
cat_contract.lighting: Rendered inside the unchanged pass-4 scene at (10.75,7.75), with the exact camera and its existing lighting. Soft contact shadow included.
cat_contract.walk: Four actual 3D orientations. Advance 0.32 tiles per 10-frame cycle; stance feet move backward at the corresponding speed. No travel is baked into the frame.
cat_contract.idle: sleep and sit are three-second loops; stretch is an optional two-second one-shot, standing to stretch to standing.

tyre_spray_contract.placement: P(wheel_u,wheel_v)-anchor, at ground contact. Add below vehicle bodies and walkers.
tyre_spray_contract.playback: One-shot 12 frames at 24fps; first and last frames black. Emit while moving on wet road. Direction is vehicle travel direction.
tyre_spray_contract.style: Original deterministic ballistic droplets, cool wet-road highlights, on black; @2x doubles each source cell.

janitor_contract.character: Original cap, short-sleeve work shirt, stitched blue overalls, work boots, straw broom, metal pail and wristwatch.
janitor_contract.placement: Top-left = P(u,v)-anchor. Sort at 1000+round((u+v)*100), just like cat. Contact shadow included.
janitor_contract.frames: Straight RGBA; row-major; floor(elapsedSeconds*fps)%frames. All coordinates are 1x; @2x doubles source cells.
janitor_contract.walk: 12 frames at 12fps; translate 0.48 tiles per cycle (0.48 tiles/second). Stance feet counter-travel at that speed.
janitor_contract.sweep: Three-second repeating sweep; pail rests next to janitor.
janitor_contract.idle: Three-second breathing/leaning loop with a wristwatch check; pail rests next to janitor.

umbrella_contract.anchor: The curved handle grip, not the umbrella centre. For a 50px emote, suggested grip=P(u,v,40)+[10,0]; top-left=grip-anchor.
umbrella_contract.placement: Keep with its owner, immediately above the owner in depth order; never use a global foreground layer.
umbrella_contract.fold: Six frames at 12fps, 0.5s one-shot. Clamp at frame 5, then remove or hold the folded umbrella. Frame 0 equals open.
umbrella_contract.resolution: Straight RGBA, shaded 3D fabric and ribs. 88x80 logical cells; @2x doubles all source dimensions.

door_anim_contract.playback: 16 frames at 18fps (0.889s), row-major, open-hold-close. Clamp at frame 15 and remove. Both endpoints transparent.
door_anim_contract.composition: Straight RGBA source-over at x,y, z_index=900, above base+ambient and below all walkers and occluders. Never plus-lighter.
door_anim_contract.background: Opaque rendered doorway core erases closed leaves and their ambient porthole glow; signed source-over floor changes add spill. Designed over this pack base+ambient or lit_bg.
door_anim_contract.mask: Doorway and floor only; neighbouring wall posters and title planes are excluded from the RGBA replacement.
door_anim_contract.resolution: frame_width/frame_height and positions are 1x; file_2x doubles cells only.
door_anim_contract.doors: Door pivots and opening positions are unchanged. Screen leaves swing inward 79 degrees; WC is a single inward leaf.

shelter_drip_contract.placement: One front-left roof corner at P(0.35,9.6,84)=[345,564.5]; puddle centre P(0.35,9.6)=[345,648.5].
shelter_drip_contract.playback: Same 72-frame, 24fps, three-second additive contract as the inherited prop loops. Frame 72 regenerated equal to frame 0.
shelter_drip_contract.style: Three gravity-accelerating drops per period with spreading perspective rings over a small blue-grey puddle.

wet_print.render: 4x Cycles water tread, area reduced in premultiplied space; unchanged dimetric camera

item_contract.placement: Top-left = attachment screen point - item.anchor. w/h/anchor are logical 1x pixels, also when file_2x is displayed at w by h.
item_contract.alpha: Straight RGBA; ordinary source-over. Transparent pixels have zero RGB. Internal shadows and highlights are baked; no ground shadow.
item_contract.carried: Popcorn and soda attach at the visible bottom centre. Suggested attachment for a 50px emote: its lower right, chosen by the page.
item_contract.staff: Both caps attach at their visible bottom centre; place this at the top centre of the roughly 50px emote.
item_contract.paper: Stub and ticket attach at their image centre. The whole ticket has a half-pixel vertical anchor because its canvas is 11px high. Rotate/translate around this point for a flying ticket.
item_contract.depth: Keep an attached item with its owner and draw it immediately above the emote. These sprites introduce no new floor footprints.
item_contract.render: Original procedural 3D, unchanged layout-2 orthographic camera and pass-6 lighting at P(8,7,50). Cycles 4x supersampling filtered to 2x then 1x with premultiplied area averaging.

vehicle_indicator_only_contract.definition: light_indicator_only = max(light_indicator - light, 0), applied per sRGB RGB channel to the delivered maps independently at 1x and 2x.
vehicle_indicator_only_contract.composition: Draw one normal OR brake light map, then add light_indicator_only only while the amber signal is on. Use plus-lighter / additive RGB clamped to 255, below all vehicle bodies.
vehicle_indicator_only_contract.placement: Use the same top-left P(u,v)-direction.anchor, width and height as the selected closed/open light and body. Door-open indicator fields are nested under door_open.
vehicle_indicator_only_contract.off: Hide the indicator-only layer. No new light or vehicle animation timing is imposed.
vehicle_indicator_only_contract.compatibility: Inherited light_indicator remains a complete replacement light map; all existing fields and contracts are unchanged. The new additive-only files contain no normal headlights or tail lights.

rain_fg.holdout: All current scene geometry, including shelter and interior foreground.

cloud_contract.neon: two separate physical tube circuits alternate every 12 frames (0.50 seconds); off circuit remains dark glass
cloud_contract.no_green_aperture: Retired in out9; layout 3 uses in-world ad quads.
cloud_contract.marquee: Dim amber, four smooth chase groups, 2 second period
cloud_contract.rain: Draft 10 wet layers, ponds, GN drips/crowns/pours, curb flow and reflection-only catchers; GN rain motion blur disabled
cloud_contract.background_plate: Per-channel cycle minimum in display space; positive delta reconstructs each rendered background exactly.

rain_production_contract.timing: 48 frames / 24 fps / 2 seconds, row-major; keep phase continuous; per-object phase offsets supported.
rain_production_contract.umbrella: umbrella.wet[colour] replaces the open sprite, source-over, unchanged 88x80 / [44,68].
rain_production_contract.roof_rain: Array order matches the selected state slices exactly. Place at P(u,lane)-parent.anchor+[x,y]; plus-lighter immediately above that body slice at its du depth. Do not add an unsliced overlay.
rain_production_contract.spray: Plus-lighter at P(u,lane)-spray.anchor, above body. full_speed=1.8 tiles/s; smoothstep(.15,1.8,abs(speed)), approximately .15s stop/start fade.
rain_production_contract.wake: Plus-lighter at road depth below body. full_speed=1.8 tiles/s. Local patches advect opposite travel at 1.8 tiles/s; .40s bus / .32s car lifetime. Other speeds require road-stamped samples or travelled-distance UV control as in NOTES-52.
rain_production_contract.resolution: All dimensions, offsets and anchors are logical 1x pixels. At dpr>1.3 use file_2x and double source sampling dimensions; load one resolution per sheet.
rain_production_contract.lighting: Same baked reference lighting at (u=6,v=11); no new lighting variants.

brief95.what: Lobby re-render list (Brief 95): wet look outdoors, lettering removed, cargo gate at the head of the alley, wall tops in their occluder pictures, page items baked.
brief95.mist_maps: catch, height, rim, light (1x and 2x) are at the pack root: load with mistdir=<this pack>
brief95.layer_packs: out10m, out10l and out10p are not part of this pack and still lie over it
